title.narrative: STRENGTHENING SOCIAL PARTNERS AND CIVIL SOCIETY CAPACITIES ON FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES AND RIGHTS AT WORK

description.narrative: The implementation entails supporting workers¿ and employers¿ organisations and civil society organisations working in the field of labour rights with a view of increasing their knowledge and capacities in the context of changing working conditions The envisaged entity has been selected using the following criteria: (a) With its tripartite structure (consisting of governments, employers and workers), ILO has an unique mandate on labour issues; (b) ILO has an obligation to develop principles and guidelines for governments, workers¿ and employers¿ organisations and other stakeholders ensuring that fundamental principles and rights at work are recognised and upheld for all; and (c) ILO has the technical expertise to implement this activity. The implementation by this entity entails improving knowledge and technical capacity of target groups, enhancing adaptation and policy making capacity for the future of work, enhancing social dialogue mechanisms, establishment of sustainable policy advocacy platforms and networks as well as financial support to third parties for social partner, business membership organisations and CSOs.
